# Bid the finished SF, the scope, and the extras.

> Price a basement finish from finished square feet, rec-room versus framed-finish versus legal-living, drop ceiling versus drywall, carpet versus LVP, bath, egress, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $30 / SF special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
